To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the service domain is more important than other domains for banks in terms of m-payment services.
the most important issues in m-payment business model are security related issues, and the service domain is the key domain in the m-payment business model.
security related issues are the most important design issues in the m-payment services from banks perspective.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a critical analysis of the m-payment business model and the design of the m-payment system from the banks'perspective.
the analysis of business model from banks' perspective.
the business model design of m-payment services and the critical design issues of the business model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
banks are not yet fully convinced of the business model of m-payment.
the m-payment services should be designed and developed based on a service oriented approach.
m-payment is a complex and dynamic system and the success of m-payment services is highly dependent on the design of the business model and the alignment of the interests of all the key stakeholders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the banks should be more focused on the service design and security issues.
m-payment services are a complex ecosystem with multiple stakeholders and the analysis of the critical design issues is essential for successful deployment.
the STOF business modeling framework is a suitable tool for analyzing business models in m-payment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the banks' perspective is very different from the perspective of other actors in the m-payment ecosystem.
the m-payment business model is a complex and multi-faceted concept.
the business model for m-payment services is not yet mature.
